# Guest functions the Switch CPU profile found hot. The round 6 list (LTO build, 480p hub run: game, render, audio,
# worker and loader threads; at least 2 samples), then, from round 14, those of the 600 with the most samples in the
# round 13 profile (config 1: 14 reports, hub and stages, all threads) that have no double-precision or vector
# floating-point arithmetic: the attribute can change GCC's unrolling and with it its multiply-add choices, so it is
# left as it was on those. tools/switch-direct-calls.py marks their definitions PPC_HOT_FUNC_IMPL: GCC optimises them
# harder and places them together in .text.hot. Regenerate from a new profile with tools/switch-cpu-profile.py
# --hot-list (and the same filter) once a new PGO profile is collected.
